name: Happy Harem Script ~Konna ni H na Onna no Ko ga Jitsuzai Suru Wake ga Nai!~
original_name: ハッピー・ハーレム・スクリプト～こんなにHな女の子が実在するワケがない！～
source:
The protagonist, Masaki, is an aspiring writer. Suddenly, he finds himself boarding at a relative's house, running a small restaurant together with his younger sister Ayano, a few days after the move.

Recently, he received a job offer to write erotic novels, but things are not going as smoothly as he hoped. The pressure from his editor, Kayo, to deliver the work is intense, and he is mentally and emotionally drained.

One day, Ayano, unable to bear seeing her brother in distress, speaks up.

"Shall I help you out?"

Driven by the pursuit of authenticity in his writing and fueled by his own desires, Masaki accepts Ayano's proposal and becomes involved with her. This leads to even closer relationships with the sisters from their relative's household.

[Translated from [url=https://www.actress.ne.jp/products/HHS/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
立志成为作家的正树搬到亲戚家寄住，数日后便与妹妹绫乃一起经营小餐馆。
最近他接到撰写色情小说的工作，却不如期待般顺利。编辑加代催稿的压力极大，令他身心俱疲。
一天，绫乃无法忍受哥哥的痛苦，开口说道：
「要我帮你吗？」
为了写作真实感，也出于自身欲望，正树接受绫乃提议，与她发生关系。这又让他与亲戚家中的姐妹们发展出更亲密的关系。

[译自[url=https://www.actress.ne.jp/products/HHS/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
